title: 50 fiberglass motorboats handed to Dinagat Islands fisherfolk
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Fifty fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) motorized boats were turned over to fisherfolk beneficiaries in Dinagat Islands as part of the province’s 20th founding…

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Fifty fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) motorized boats were turned over to fisherfolk beneficiaries in Dinagat Islands as part of the province’s 20th founding anniversary celebration on Monday, its Public Information Office reported. The boats were distributed under the “Bangka Ko, Gawa Ko” Project, implemented by the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) in partnership with the Provincial Government of Dinagat Islands. The assistance aims to improve the livelihood of local fisherfolk and strengthen the province’s fisheries sector, a key contributor to its economy and food production.
